Results.ReviewText: Bought the grill pre-assembled. Brought it home, hooked up the tank and it didn't work, very difficult to light, gas sound like a jet plane, when it did ignite, it almost took my eyebrows off. Flames shot out of the grill. Needless to say, something wasn't right. I contacted Weber, sent them a video of what has happening, the sent out a new regulator and new burner tubes.... installed very quickly, and still the same problem. Contacted again and in a few days, they sent a new manifold system for the grill. That fixed the problem,. Over all it took about 2-3 weeks to get my grill in operation order. Now I have to clean all the black soot off of it from the huge flames. It's in operation order now and so far I'm pretty impressed in the quality of the food I have been able to prepare. So after a false start (which is why I give 4 stars) So far so good.

Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-310 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText: The thing is really well built. It has heavy gauge steel and nice heavy grills that don't slide around. It gets hot really fast because the lid has a lower profile than most. The 'how much propane do I have left?' feature is great! No more guessing. I got it with the iGrill option and that has been really good to use... knowing the exact temperature of the meat and when it's done. The app in iOS is pretty easy to use.
Results.Title: Best grill I've owned as yet

Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-310 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText:
My husband researched which gas grill we wanted to purchase to replace our Green Egg. We did not enjoy the time it took to set up and light the Egg and wanted a gas grill to turn on and cook quickly. The grill has been just what we needed. I can cook a small meal in a few minutes or use all three burners to cook for a larger group. Cleaning and maintenance has been a breeze as well. We grill weekly year-round so the investment in a better quality product was worth it to us. I cannot speak to the assembly process because we purchased from a locally owned hardware store that delivered the grill fully assembled. 

I do think a grill cover should be included with this product (I purchased the weber cover online for less than $40 so I would think it would be a nominal cost to include with the grill and a nice perk with purchase). The cover works great and keeps the grill clean and free from debris/weather. 

I would recommend covering the drip pan with aluminum foil before placing the foil pan inserts in the tray for easier clean up and changing. Otherwise the main pan is also dirty and needs to be cleaned each time you change the insert.
Results.Title: High quality product and easy to use!

We use it at least 3 times a week and the results are excellent.  Only wish I hadn't waited so long to buy a new Weber.

Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-310 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText:
My Wife and I were debating Charcoal or Gas. My wife was afraid the food would have that "natural gas" flavor that can sometimes happen, and Charcoal is cheaper. But We decided to go with the Gas because you don't have to wait as long. Safe to say none of those flavor issues. I've used other Grills in the past and I've NEVER had a grill that heated up to 400/500 degrees as fast. Also, the food cooks evenly no Cold spots. The heat is right in the center where I need it to be. It is by far my favorite grill that I have ever worked with.
One down side, $50 for a cover. At $450 you should throw in a cover. Assembling it was fairly easy. Some of the pictures/drawings in the manual and on the app weren't quite as clear as I would have liked. But it was pretty straight forward to assemble it.

I assembled the grill myself and the parts are well-made.  My only complaint is that grease from whatever I’m cooking collects on the sides of the top cover. The grease drips onto the front of the grill storage area and my patio pavers.  It is something I have to clean after every use.  It’s not something I expected from a $450 grill.  I think Weber can do better based on the extremely satisfied previous owners of other Weber grills that insisted I buy a Weber for my next grill.

Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-310 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText:
Love this grill after 2 months of use. The key feature is that the grill hits 600F within just 3 minutes of heating (in the spring/summer). So I go from BBQ off to seared steaks in about 11 minutes total. My friend was blown away to see that my grill could exceed 500 (compared to his grill). I first ran this grill for 20mins on high on all burners and hit about 700F (the handle was too hot to touch)! Have also used this with a smoker box and can smoke meat for hours with ease to get that great flavor and smell. 

Cons: The scale for the propane tank can stick a bit and isn't too helpful. Assembly was a bit challenging when I couldnt find a part. Unit came with a bent stand that was replaced by Weber.

Key reasons why you should consider this grill: intensely high heat, even heat, ease of assembly.
HIGHLY recommend!
Results.Title: Hits 600 F within 3 minutes

Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-310 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText: The unit has a lot less pieces to assemble than most.  It is good that the cooking main cooker is per-assembled.  Much of it is cast alumimum so it won't rust.  Of particular interest is the way the burners and flavor slats are mounted.  They are mounted to the aluminum casting so will not become lose and useless later on due to rust as many others are made.  The only drawback is the lighting from left to right, but this is just a learning experience and may even be a benefit for left handed users.  Had hoped it would be made in USA instead of China but the QC on production seems to have been good.
Results.Title: Should last a long time

Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-310 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText: My Genesis lasted 9 years cooked fine now my Spirit is just as good thanks

Results.ReviewText: This is my second Webber gas grill. I won’t buy any other grill. Living in NH I grill year round. Plus I have it hooked up to my 500 gallon propane tank so I never have to change a propane tank on the grill.

Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-310 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText: This is the best gas grill I have owned in the last 30 years! Easy to put together with very clear instructions. Temperature control very stable, no ups or downs. Grease removal system wonderful and cleaning a breeze. In the month we have grilled almost every day and I have not burned anything yet. Very few flare ups due to  excellent design.
Results.Title: Satisfaction

Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-310 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText: The instructions showed two burly men assembling the grill and I do ordinarily rely on the men in my family to do this sort of thing for me.  Fortunately, I was able to do everything all by myself except for holding the lid while popping the pins back in.  Everything went together easily, all the parts were there.  The instructions were great, including features to look for to make sure parts were oriented properly, etc.  And when I was done, I fired that thing up like a champ.  Everything worked.  In general, I'm very pleased aside from the picture of those men.
Results.Title: I assembled it myself!

Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-310 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText: I've been using this for a couple of months (on my 2nd tank of gas) and love it.  It heats up quickly, cooks evenly and am totally happy that I chose this model.  My son-in-law purchased one also based on hearing how satisfied I was.
